## What Problem Is Being Solved?

IoT devices generate sensor data that is only useful when it can be monitored in real time. This dashboard provides a central web interface to view and manage sensor data streams for the faculty.

## How It Works

A web application built with **Laravel (Blade)** that collects, stores, and visualizes IoT sensor readings in an accessible dashboard.

## My Role

Designer and developer of the dashboard application.

## What Was Produced

A deployable IoT monitoring dashboard for the Faculty of Science and Technology.
